review_evidence: LeanTea/Auth/Proof.lean defines dependent capability certificates, typed authorized routes, and secure dispatch interfaces; these are substantive Lean definitions even though this repository is application-oriented rather than theorem-heavy.
The source tree also includes parser/compiler, crypto, persistence, networking, RPC, state-machine, WebSpec, and test/example definitions; path roles alone do not justify exclusion.

lakefile.lean was inspected directly: its definitions, targets, extern_lib declarations, environment probes, and executable declarations are Lake build/link configuration for C/SQLite/MySQL/PostgreSQL/TLS integration.

rules.content_invariant: Excluding the inspected lakefile leaves all LeanTea and LeanJs source definitions, typed security interfaces, examples, and application specifications retained; only build/link orchestration is removed from primary formalization search.
evidence: Direct inspection shows package/lean_lib/target/extern_lib/lean_exe configuration and platform/environment-dependent linker setup; these definitions exist solely to configure the build.
rules.rationale: This exact file is Lake build, target, external-library, and linker configuration rather than a LeanTea domain specification or formal application interface.

summary: Reviewed lean-tea; retain the LeanTea/LeanJs libraries and examples because they define typed application/security/state-machine/compiler interfaces, excluding only the inspected build-system lakefile.
